text: Welcome to F M B P, Find My Business Partner. A hyperlocal app where small businesses across India find investors, suppliers, customers and partners near them. Signing in takes just your mobile number and a one time password.
Creating your business profile takes under a minute. Only three things: a name, a category, and a location. Everything else is optional and can be added later.

This is the Opportunities feed. Every card shows what a business needs or offers, the amount, and a trust row with response rate, ratings and member since. Tabs give you Latest, Nearby, For you, Trending, plus businesses you follow and posts you saved.
Open a post to see the full details. Here, Ravi Restaurant in Noida needs five lakh rupees to expand. Responding is one tap: Let's talk.
A response opens a chat with the owner, anchored to the post, and messages arrive in real time. Here is Ravi replying right away.
All your conversations live in the Chats tab, with unread indicators, so no lead is lost.

Now let's post our own need. Tap Post. First pick what you want to do: need something, offer something, partner, invest, or announce. Under Need, there are more than twenty options, with a quick filter. Let's say we need customers.
The form is short and tap first: when do you need it, a budget, and where, which is pre filled from your business. Advanced details stay hidden under More details for those who want them.
F M B P writes the post for you, in English or Hindi. You can edit or remove the text, then publish.
Your post is live and visible to businesses nearby, ranked by distance, freshness and relevance.
Search finds posts, offerings and businesses by keyword, tag, or city.
My Business shows your profile completion. Each item you add builds trust. Let's add a description and a phone number with one tap.
And the whole app is available in Hindi from day one.
That is F M B P. Post a need in a minute, discover opportunities nearby, and talk directly to the right partner. Thank you for watching.
